req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-038 requires that PUT /players/{playerId} returns HTTP 422 when called without a request body. The actual endpoint in the source is PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Three test cases are designed: (1) NEG — send PUT with no body at all, expect 422; (2) EP positive — send PUT with a valid body for an existing player, expect 204 (proves the route works normally, anchoring the 422 as body-absence specific); (3) BVA boundary — send PUT with an empty JSON object '{}' (body present but all required fields missing), expect 422. Together these cover the error pathway (422), the happy path (204), and the boundary between 'no body' and 'empty body'. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code integer 422 (catches constant mutations like 422->400 or 422->200) and 204 (catches 204->200 or 204->422).

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import json

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    response = client.put(
        "/players/squadnumber/10",
        content=json.dumps(payload),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )
    assert response.status_code == 204

test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204()

tests.name: test_put_player_missing_required_fields_only_optional_present_returns_422
preconditions: Application is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Lionel Messi)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a body containing only optional fields (middleName, team) but missing all required fields (firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position)
expected: Response body contains 'detail' key with validation errors
trace: R-PLAYER-038: body present but required fields absent — Pydantic validation must reject with 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import json

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_missing_required_fields_only_optional_present_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain"
    }
    response = client.put(
        "/players/squadnumber/10",
        content=json.dumps(payload),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )
    assert response.status_code == 422
    body = response.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)

test_put_player_missing_required_fields_only_optional_present_returns_422()
